subject.title: fix(skills): enforce 256 MiB skill download cap in-stream

question: Should all direct skill artifact downloads become fail-closed above a fixed 256 MiB ceiling?
rationale: A finite in-stream bound is necessary for resource safety, but choosing 256 MiB creates a new compatibility contract that can reject previously valid artifacts and is not established by the current skill schema or documentation.

options.title: Confirm 256 MiB contract
options.body: Adopt 256 MiB as the supported ceiling, document the contract, and require live installer proof before merge.

options.title: Choose another ceiling
options.body: Keep the in-stream mechanism but replace 256 MiB with an explicitly approved artifact-policy limit covering all supported downloads.

options.title: Pause the hard cap
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers define how oversized existing skill artifacts should be handled without an undocumented installation break.

recommendation.title: Confirm 256 MiB contract
recommendation.body: Adopt 256 MiB as the supported ceiling, document the contract, and require live installer proof before merge.
